dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with highly irregular, crenulated dark perimeters. Transition from dark exterior to light grey interior is sharp, with pixel-level jaggedness along the boundary of the three most prominent anterior structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized in the interstitial gaps between larger annular rings on the anterior-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the anterior flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented longitudinally towards the posterior.
